paper.title_en: Dark vector meson effects on composite dark matter
paper.abstract_en: We extend previous studies of $\mathcal{G}$-parity-odd dark pion dark matter in a QCD-like $\mathrm{SU}(N_c)$ gauge theory with electroweakly interacting dark quarks to include the effects of $ρ$ mesons. We show that vector mesons can substantially affect relic abundance calculations through resonant enhancement, significantly affecting the conditions required to reproduce the observed relic abundance. Electroweak interactions further induce mixing between the dark $ρ$ mesons and Standard Model gauge bosons, opening new decay channels for the dark $ρ$ and modifying the effective interactions of the dark pions. We recast existing ATLAS and CMS searches to constrain the model, and perform a collider phenomenology study targeting the future FCC-hh and muon colliders, focusing on the resonant enhancement of cross sections in the $e^+e^-$, $μ^+μ^-$, and $W^+W^-$ final states for the latter. We show that the FCC-hh could probe $ρ$ mesons whose mass is up to 40 TeV.
